request_text: Identify each employee with knowledge of the failed delivery and describe the facts known by each person.
response_text: Defendant served no interrogatory answers by the response deadline.
meet_and_confer_text: Plaintiff requested overdue answers and warned that a motion would follow if no response was served.
motion_text: Plaintiff moves to compel complete verified interrogatory answers and requests $750 in reasonable fees for the motion.
opposition_text: Defendant says the omission was an oversight but gives no substantive justification for serving no answers.
context_notes: Clean grant: no response and no justification.

request_text: Identify each person who participated in contract negotiations.
response_text: Defendant identified three negotiators, gave dates, and stated that no other employee participated.
meet_and_confer_text: Plaintiff demanded narrative detail about every meeting despite the complete identification answer.
motion_text: Plaintiff moves to compel a broader answer and asks for fees.
opposition_text: Defendant argues the interrogatory asked for identities, all identities were provided, and no unresolved deficiency remains.
context_notes: Clean denial: the requested discovery was already answered.

case_theme: Defendant gave an evasive interrogatory response.
request_text: State the factual basis for each denial in the answer.
response_text: Defendant responded only that it denies liability and will supplement later if necessary.
meet_and_confer_text: Plaintiff requested the factual basis for the denials, but defendant refused to add detail.
motion_text: Plaintiff moves to compel a complete interrogatory answer and requests $650 in fees.
opposition_text: Defendant says the answer is enough because discovery is early, but it identifies no burden or privilege.
context_notes: Clean grant: evasive answer with no substantial justification.

case_theme: Privilege objection is targeted and logged.
request_text: Produce all emails with litigation counsel about trial strategy.
response_text: Plaintiff objected on attorney-client and work-product grounds, produced a privilege log, and produced nonprivileged business emails.
meet_and_confer_text: Defendant demanded the logged attorney communications without narrowing the request.
motion_text: Defendant moves to compel the logged counsel communications and asks for fees.
opposition_text: Plaintiff argues the request targets protected communications and that nonprivileged responsive material was produced.
context_notes: Clean denial: targeted privilege and work-product objection.

case_theme: Plaintiff served an overbroad document request.
request_text: Produce every internal message about any customer complaint over the last ten years.
response_text: Defendant objected that the request is overbroad and offered to produce messages about the contract, delivery, and support tickets at issue.
meet_and_confer_text: Plaintiff refused the proposed narrowing and demanded the full ten-year customer-complaint archive.
motion_text: Plaintiff moves to compel all documents requested and asks for $900 in fees.
opposition_text: Defendant argues the request sweeps far beyond the claim and that it offered a targeted production.
context_notes: Contextual denial: overbreadth and proportionality justify resistance.

case_theme: Backup restoration burden outweighs the likely value.
request_text: Restore six years of backup images to search for drafts of invoices already produced in final form.
response_text: Plaintiff produced final invoices and active-system drafts, objecting that backup restoration would cost more than the disputed amount.
meet_and_confer_text: Defendant refused search-term narrowing or a sample restoration.
motion_text: Defendant moves to compel full backup restoration and seeks fees.
opposition_text: Plaintiff argues the request is disproportionate because the final invoices and available drafts already cover the relevant issue.
context_notes: Contextual denial: proportionality objection is justified.

case_theme: Late supplement cured the defect before hearing.
request_text: Identify the custodian for the delivery logs.
response_text: Defendant first omitted the custodian, then served a verified supplement naming the custodian and explaining the logs two days before the motion hearing.
meet_and_confer_text: Plaintiff filed the motion after the supplement arrived and identified no remaining gap.
motion_text: Plaintiff moves to compel and seeks $500 in fees based on the late original answer.
opposition_text: Defendant argues the supplement cured the defect and plaintiff identifies no prejudice from the short delay.
context_notes: Contextual denial: no unresolved deficiency or prejudice.

case_theme: Plaintiff omitted a key witness from initial disclosures.
request_text: Rule 26 initial disclosures required individuals likely to have discoverable information.
response_text: Plaintiff omitted the only warehouse supervisor with first-hand knowledge of delivery receipt and identified the witness only after deposition scheduling closed.
meet_and_confer_text: Defendant asked for supplementation and deposition dates; plaintiff refused to reopen scheduling.
motion_text: Defendant moves for Rule 37 relief, asks to compel supplementation and deposition availability, and requests $500 in fees.
opposition_text: Plaintiff says the omission was harmless because the supervisor's name appears in produced emails, but plaintiff did not disclose the witness as required.
context_notes: Contextual grant: required disclosure omitted without harmlessness.

case_theme: Defendant disobeyed a prior discovery order.
request_text: Produce delivery telemetry files for the week of the outage.
response_text: After a prior court order compelled production by July 10, defendant produced only a summary spreadsheet and withheld the telemetry files.
meet_and_confer_text: Plaintiff asked for compliance with the order; defendant said the summary should be enough.
motion_text: Plaintiff moves for sanctions for failure to obey the court's prior discovery order and requests $1,000 in fees.
opposition_text: Defendant argues the summary is equivalent to the telemetry files, but does not dispute that the order required the files.
context_notes: Contextual grant: violation of prior order.

request_text: Admit that plaintiff received the replacement shipment on May 14 and paid no additional charge.
response_text: Plaintiff served no responses or objections to the requests for admission.
meet_and_confer_text: Defendant requested responses and warned that a Rule 37 motion would seek fees.
motion_text: Defendant moves to compel RFA responses and asks for $400 in fees.
opposition_text: Plaintiff says RFAs are less important than document production and asks for more time without explaining the missed deadline.
context_notes: Contextual denial: unanswered RFAs are admitted under Rule 36.

case_theme: Defendant withheld the central production files.
request_text: Produce native delivery logs and the audit trail for the disputed transaction window.
response_text: Defendant produced PDF screenshots but withheld native logs and the audit trail, stating only that screenshots are easier to review.
meet_and_confer_text: Plaintiff requested the native files and explained why the audit trail is needed to test timestamps.
motion_text: Plaintiff moves to compel native logs and the audit trail and requests $900 in fees.
opposition_text: Defendant does not claim burden or privilege and says screenshots should satisfy plaintiff.
context_notes: Adversarial grant: incomplete production framed as convenience.

case_theme: Plaintiff moved before the response deadline.
request_text: Identify all software versions used in the transaction system.
response_text: The response deadline has not expired, and defendant confirmed responses will be served by the deadline.
meet_and_confer_text: Plaintiff filed the motion ten days before the response deadline without waiting for answers.
motion_text: Plaintiff moves to compel immediate responses and seeks $500 in fees.
opposition_text: Defendant argues the motion is premature because no discovery response is overdue.
context_notes: Adversarial denial: no current failure to respond.

case_theme: Incomplete answer should be compelled without fees.
request_text: State the method used to calculate claimed consequential damages.
response_text: Plaintiff described total damages but omitted the calculation method because a spreadsheet formula was corrupted; plaintiff offered to supplement once the file was restored.
meet_and_confer_text: Plaintiff acknowledged the omission and served the restored spreadsheet after the motion was filed but before decision.
motion_text: Defendant moves to compel a complete explanation of the calculation method and requests $600 in fees.
opposition_text: Plaintiff agrees to provide a verified supplemental answer and argues fees would be unjust because the omission came from a corrupted produced spreadsheet and was corrected promptly.
context_notes: Adversarial grant without fees: compel completion, but fee award is unjust.

request_text: Produce counsel's notes evaluating witness credibility after interviews.
response_text: Defendant objected on work-product grounds, logged the notes, and produced nonprivileged witness statements and communications.
meet_and_confer_text: Plaintiff demanded the notes because credibility is important at trial.
motion_text: Plaintiff moves to compel attorney interview notes and asks for fees.
opposition_text: Defendant argues the request seeks protected opinion work product and that factual witness materials have been produced.

request_text: Produce purchase orders and payment confirmations for the replacement shipment.
response_text: Plaintiff objected that the request is vague, burdensome, and irrelevant, and produced no documents despite relying on the replacement shipment in the complaint.
meet_and_confer_text: Defendant narrowed the request to two purchase-order numbers, but plaintiff kept the objections and produced nothing.
motion_text: Defendant moves to compel production and requests $600 in fees.
opposition_text: Plaintiff repeats boilerplate objections and does not explain any burden, privilege, or lack of possession.
context_notes: Adversarial grant: boilerplate objections without support.

case_theme: Movant seeks fees after full production.
request_text: Produce support tickets for the disputed transaction.
response_text: Defendant produced all support tickets before the Rule 37 motion was filed and confirmed no responsive tickets were withheld.
meet_and_confer_text: Plaintiff acknowledged receiving the tickets but argued defendant should pay fees for delay during earlier correspondence.
motion_text: Plaintiff moves for Rule 37 fees only and does not ask for any further response or production.
opposition_text: Defendant argues there is no unresolved discovery failure before the court and that Rule 37 relief is unwarranted.
context_notes: Adversarial denial: fee-only motion without unresolved failure.
